references.observed: Actually inspected whole SE/SW aerial oblique:complete warm light-stone cathedral withlong high nave/clerestory,lower terracotta aisles andchapel roofs,many stepped/flying buttresses andpinnacles,polygonal high apse,large central ribbed dome/lantern,front great bell tower withopen tall belfry anddomed cap,lower octagonal portal turret withslate cap,andthe separate closed cloister ranges aroundan open square court. Cityneighbors remain independent. Exact rear doorinventory andpinnacle ornament remainapproximate.
